Robert Tijdeman

Universiteit van Amsterdam

A Dutch number theorist, long based at Leiden University, known for Diophantine equations and Diophantine approximation. His 1976 theorem showing Catalan's equation has only finitely many solutions was a major step toward the eventual proof of Catalan's conjecture.
